verdict.rationale: Salv's own marketing page states that Salv Monitoring deploys as cloud, private cloud or on-premise, which is a first-party self-hosting claim for one core module. It is a single marketing line with no deployment documentation, and the other API docs describe a hosted SaaS with app and demo environments. Missing for 10: self-hosting/installation documentation, confirmation that screening, cases and other modules can also be self-hosted, licensing or requirements details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an on-premise deployment.
